decision.title: XSLT 1.0 follow-ups: EXSLT common, text value templates, result documents (packet 7.4b)

item.p: name.h (frozen, additive, ): SXML_NAMESPACE_EXSLT_COMMON = 15 for http://exslt.org/common, SXML_NAMESPACE_WELL_KNOWN_COUNT 16. Needed because a function row names its namespace by a well-known constant (sxml_native_function.function_namespace); the list only grows and no value changes.

EXSLT common: src/function_library_exslt.c, an XSLT-only library part (as output, ) with exsl:node-set (returns its argument: a temporary tree is already a document node in XSLT 2.0 and later) and exsl:object-type ("string", "number", "boolean", "node-set" for nodes and the empty sequence, "external" otherwise). function-available reports them. No other EXSLT module: DocBook tests the others (dyn:evaluate, set:leading, date:date-time, str:*) with function-available first, and no XT40 case needs them.

exsl:document in an extension namespace (24.2) is read as xsl:result-document (src/xslt_read.c): its attributes are a subset of xsl:result-document's (26.2), all attribute value templates; an unprefixed version attribute reads as the standard attribute, as on any XSLT element. element-available('exsl:document') is true. DocBook's chunker writes its secondary files through it (docbook-001 raised XTMM9000 "Can't make chunks" without it). Outside an extension namespace it stays a literal result element.

docbook-002's XPST0003 was fo/autoidx.xsl's xsl:key: its use attribute names entities of the external parameter entity common/entities.ent, which the module reader did not retrieve, so the expression lost its first argument. 7.14 (, 7a0c96a) now reads a module's external entities through the resolver; nothing else was needed.

Text value templates in an element with XSLT 1.0 behaviour are lowered without XPath 1.0 compatibility mode (XSLT 4.0, 3.8.1): the value template frame lowers its expressions in a copy of the element's static context with the mode off.

xsl:result-document whose result is the principal result (no href) chooses its default method as an explicit result document: xhtml for an XHTML html element, also in a 1.0 stylesheet (XSLT 4.0, 26.1).

Numbers (release, XT40 whole suite, case by case, against 46cc929): 8,940 to 8,943 passed: docbook-001, docbook-002, backwards-019b; no other case changed. Unit tests in tests/xslt_compatibility_test.c.

Size (wasm preset, MinSizeRel objects): src/xpath_compatibility.c is 6,024 bytes of code and 1,133 of data before linking, all in sxml.wasm, because the XPath lowering calls it; the EXSLT part is 961 bytes of code and 285 of data, also linked into the core through the part registry. At 01a3993 sxml.wasm is 2,294,051 bytes stripped (801,300 gzipped), over its 2,200,000 / 770,000 budget; these two files are about 8.4 KB of that.
